description: This file defines a PHP class 'TestCaseParams' used as a data container for test case parameters within an integration testing context in the OrangeHRM project. It includes properties for various test configurations, getter and setter methods, and constants used for test hooks.

classes.name: TestCaseParams
classes.description: A class used to encapsulate parameters and configurations for integration test cases, including attributes like user ID, services, attributes, expected results, exception info, and hooks.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name identifier of the test case.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name identifier of the test case.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID associated with the test case.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the test case.

methods.name: getServices
methods.description: Retrieves the array of services involved in the test case.

methods.name: setServices
methods.description: Sets the array of services involved in the test case.

methods.name: getFactories
methods.description: Retrieves the array of factories used in the test case.

methods.name: setFactories
methods.description: Sets the array of factories used in the test case.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the attributes associated with the test case.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes associated with the test case.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Retrieves the request body data for the test case.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the request body data for the test case.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the query parameters for the test case.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query parameters for the test case.

methods.name: getResultData
methods.description: Retrieves the expected result data for the test case.

methods.name: setResultData
methods.description: Sets the expected result data for the test case.

methods.name: getResultMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with the expected results.

methods.name: setResultMeta
methods.description: Sets metadata associated with the expected results.

methods.name: getInvalidOnly
methods.description: Retrieves the array indicating only invalid test inputs.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the test case is for an invalid input scenario.

methods.name: setInvalidOnly
methods.description: Sets the invalid input indicators.

methods.name: getExceptionClass
methods.description: Retrieves the class name of an expected exception.

methods.name: setExceptionClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of an expected exception.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the expected exception message.

methods.name: setExceptionMessage
methods.description: Sets the expected exception message.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Retrieves the DateTime object representing 'now' for testing purposes.

methods.name: setNowFromArray
methods.description: Sets the 'now' DateTime object from an array specifying datetime and timezone.

methods.name: getHooks
methods.description: Retrieves the array of hooks used during testing.

methods.name: getHook
methods.description: Retrieves a specific hook callable by name.

methods.name: setHooks
methods.description: Sets the array of hooks for testing.
